advanced.name: Advanced / Experimental
advanced.description: Optional high-resolution global sources. WeatherNext 3 requires a Google account with WeatherNext data access; CAMS UV requires a free ADS account token (see the Rainradar README).

data.enable_pkg_solar: Solar package (irradiance, direct beam, cloud layers)
data.enable_pkg_wind: Wind package (100 m wind speed and direction)
data.enable_pkg_probability: Probability package (24 h rain / frost / heat risk)
data.cams_api_token: ADS API token (see README for how to create one)

data_description.wn_sign_in_google: Check this to sign in with the Google account that has WeatherNext data access. Opens a Google consent screen in a new window.
data_description.cams_api_token: Format 'user@host:key'. Leave empty to keep the currently stored token.

auth.description:
Choose the Google account that has been granted WeatherNext data access (see the Rainradar README) and approve the read-only Cloud Storage permission.

This window closes automatically when you are done. If it does not, check that your browser allows pop-ups for Home Assistant.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Rainradar configuration is allowed.
abort.reauth_started: A Google sign-in window was opened. Complete it there, then reopen the Rainradar options.
abort.authorize_rejected: Google sign-in was declined or cancelled.
abort.missing_google_credentials: No Google OAuth client is configured. Add one under Settings > Devices & Services > Application Credentials first (see the Rainradar README).
abort.authorize_url_failed: Could not build the Google sign-in URL. Check the application credentials and reload.
abort.token_exchange_failed: Google rejected the sign-in. Check the OAuth client and its authorized redirect URI, then try again.
abort.no_refresh_token: Google did not return a refresh token. Revoke the app's access in your Google account settings, then sign in again.

error.sign_in_required: Enable WeatherNext 3 and check 'Sign in with Google' to connect your Google account.
error.invalid_credentials: Google rejected the stored credentials. Sign in with Google again.
error.allowlist_pending: WeatherNext access not granted yet — submit the Google data request form and wait for approval (5-7 days).
error.http_500: Google Cloud Storage returned a server error; try again later.
error.no_data_found: No WeatherNext data found for the last 8 hours.
error.cams_token_required: CAMS UV requires an ADS API token.
error.invalid_token_format: The ADS token should look like 'user@example.com:secretkey'.
